Honest Review of Stellar Online OST to PST Converter: Is Online Conversion Worth It?

By Derick Payne / April 7, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:06
Instaread

If there’s one recurring nightmare when managing Microsoft 365 environments and handling IT support tickets, it’s the dreaded orphaned OST file. We’ve all been there: an Exchange server connection permanently drops, an active directory profile gets accidentally wiped, and suddenly, gigabytes of critical mailbox  data are locked in an inaccessible, encrypted Offline Storage Table (OST) file.

For years, my go-to solution has been heavy, localized desktop conversion  software. However, Stellar recently caught my attention with their browser-based alternative: the Online OST to PST Converter. I decided to put it to the test to see if an online tool could actually handle the mailbox data extraction.

Here is my completely honest, hands-on experience with the platform.

Why use an online OST to PST converter?

Before diving into the performance, it’s worth talking about why a web-based converter is such a compelling idea.

Traditionally, converting an OST to a Personal Storage Table (PST) file meant downloading robust software, ensuring you had local administrative privileges, and often wrestling with Outlook dependencies. Stellar’s OST to PST online tool eliminates all of that. Because the processing engine runs entirely on their servers, you don’t need Microsoft Outlook installed on your machine, nor do you need any connection to the original Exchange Server. You just open a browser, upload, and download.

LearnCoding Online

Evaluating the Interface: A Triumph in UI/UX Design

As a developer who spends a lot of time analyzing and building intuitive UI/UX workflows, I am highly critical of how enterprise tools are laid out. I was genuinely impressed by Stellar’s approach here.

They have completely stripped away the cluttered toolbars and intimidating configurations usually associated with file conversion tools. Instead, you are greeted with a minimalist, highly focused three-step workflow:

1. Upload your OST File

2. Convert to PST

3. Download your PST File

There is zero learning curve. The interface provides real-time progress tracking for the upload, conversion, and download phases. You aren’t left staring at a static loading bar, wondering if the browser tab crashed; you know exactly what the engine is always doing.

DownloadSecure Browsers

Real-World Performance and Speed

To give it a proper run, I tested the tool with a moderately sized, disconnected OST file.

The upload phase is, naturally, bottlenecked by your own internet service provider’s upload speeds. However, once the file was on Stellar’s servers, the conversion engine was incredibly fast. It chewed through the data and generated a clean PST file without a single hiccup.

One feature I absolutely loved was the HTML Preview. For files under 500MB, the web app generates an HTML-based preview of the converted PST file data directly in your browser. Being able to verify that the folder hierarchy, emails, contacts, and calendar metadata were perfectly intact before I committed to downloading the final archive gave me immense peace of mind. Everything was structured exactly as it was in the original mailbox.

Security and Privacy

Uploading corporate emails or personal mailbox data to a third-party online server is a massive trust exercise. It was my biggest hesitation before using the tool.

Fortunately, Stellar has implemented strict, enterprise-grade protocols. All file transfers are secured via SSL encryption. More importantly, they operate on a strict zero-data-retention policy. The platform automatically and permanently wipes your uploaded OST and the resulting PST file from its servers within 24 hours of the conversion. This compliance with privacy regulations makes it a viable tool even for sensitive business data.

Pricing: Flexible but with Hard Limits

Stellar offers a scalable pricing model, which I found to be quite fair, though you need to be aware of the limitations.

  • The Free Tier ($0): This is a fantastic entry point. If your corrupted OST file is under 500MB, you can convert it completely free of charge.
  • The Premium Tier ($29.99/mailbox): This unlocks conversion for files up to 5GB. It’s priced perfectly for one-off IT rescues.
  • The Desktop Version: Here is the catch: if you are dealing with a massive enterprise archive that exceeds the 5GB limit, the online tool will not accept it. At that point, you can purchase their flagship Desktop  Software Stellar Converter for OST ($79.99) for unlimited, local file processing & conversion.

What I Loved:

  • Zero Dependencies: No Outlook installation or Exchange server needed.
  • Brilliant UI: Clean, intuitive, and completely frictionless interface.
  • True Cross-Platform: Works on any OS with a modern  web browser.
  •  Data Integrity: Flawlessly preserved the original folder structures and metadata.
  • Secure: Solid 24-hour auto-deletion policy for uploaded data.

My Final Verdict

So, is the Online OST to PST Converter by Stellar worth your time? Absolutely. If you need to quickly rescue emails from a disconnected OST file and convert OST to PST online and want to avoid the friction of installing heavy desktop software, this is a phenomenal tool. It delivers a masterclass in clean UI design, runs incredibly fast, and respects your privacy.

Software

While heavy-duty enterprise users with massive archives will still need the desktop version, this web-based solution is a total game-changer for standard mailbox conversion. It does exactly what it promises, securely and efficiently.
